title: Caribbean Pepper Sauce - 'Peppah' Sauce
ldKeywords: hot sauce, peppah sauce, Pepper sauce, trini pepper sauce
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ lb red hot peppers (habanero, scotch bonnet, cherry pepper, wiri wiri pepper )
1 ½ cups vinegar (or enough to cover)
ldInstructionsRaw: Chop pepper and carrot into chunks large enough for the blender.
Add all the ingredients to the blender and pulse until smooth. Add more salt if required.
